en: Black‑and‑white view of a broad, straight city street lined with ornate late‑19th‑century townhouses and apartment buildings in historicist/Neo‑Baroque style. The foreground shows richly decorated facades with mansard roofs, domed corner turrets, dormer windows, and shuttered windows. Several pedestrians walk along wide sidewalks and there are simple street lamps but no cars, giving the scene an early 20th‑century feel. The street recedes toward a slightly rising hill with more buildings and trees in the distance. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.
